_readme: Single source of truth for firm details. Every TODO below is a real business fact that must be supplied by Hoffman Legal. scripts/check-placeholders.mjs fails the build if any survive into a production build.
disclosure: FloridaProbationLaw.com is a legal information and legal services website operated by Hoffman Legal.

phone._todo: TODO: replace with Hoffman Legal's main line. Leave `tel` empty until confirmed — build.mjs renders the number as plain text rather than a live tel: link while it is blank, so no visitor can dial a wrong number.

email._todo: TODO: replace with the intake inbox address.

attorney._todo: TODO: responsible attorney name and Florida Bar number. Fla. Bar Rule 4-7.12 requires the name of at least one lawyer or the law firm responsible for the content of this site.

office._todo: TODO: bona fide office address. Fla. Bar Rule 4-7.12 requires disclosing the city, town or county of at least one bona fide office location.

hours._todo: TODO: business hours, plus whether after-hours intake is available. Violation warrants are frequently issued without bond, so out-of-hours availability is a genuine differentiator if it exists.

bar._todo: TODO: Florida Bar membership details as they should be publicly stated.
